answer.text:
Based on the provided documentation, Mastra compiles your application into a standalone Node.js server (a production-ready Hono server) that can run on any platform supporting Node.js, Bun, or Deno [1, 7]. 

When you build with Mastra (`mastra build`), it creates a self-contained `.mastra` output directory containing:
- A server entry point and bundled Mastra configuration (`index.mjs`, `mastra.mjs`) [1]
- Aggregated tool exports and individual tool bundles (`tools.mjs`, `tools/`) [1]
- Production dependencies and node modules (`package.json`, `node_modules/`) [1]
- Copied static assets and optional Studio UI / playground if requested (`public/`, `playground/`) [1, 7]

Sources:
- [Mastra server](https://mastra.ai/docs/deployment/mastra-server)
- [CLI commands](https://mastra.ai/reference/cli/mastra)
